messages.subject: For William Cobb | Responsible mining, stakeholder governance and country execution
messages.body:
Dear Freeport-McMoRan Communications Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. William E. Cobb, Vice President and Chief Sustainability Officer.

Freeport-McMoRan's long-life copper portfolio depends on more than operational strength. Sustained value also rests on trusted community relationships, regulatory discipline, responsible growth and clear accountability for commitments across the business.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, community engagement, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across a major mining operation. I translate external expectations into accountable action across operations, environment, HSE, legal, HR, finance, procurement and technical teams. I also support stakeholder governance around mine-scale solar and battery infrastructure and carbon-accounting evidence work.

I would value a conversation about where this operating-side experience might support Freeport-McMoRan's sustainability, stakeholder, community or country-facing leadership priorities. My attached CV is tailored specifically to that contribution.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
